# netbox_data_source (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/integrations/synchronized-data/):

> NetBox can be configured to retrieve data from a remote source, such as a git repository or an S3 bucket, and use it to populate certain models such as config contexts and config templates. A data source represents such a remote source of data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_data_source" "example" {
  name         = "example-git-source"
  type         = "git"
  source_url   = "https://github.com/example/netbox-data.git"
  enabled      = true
  description  = "Example git-backed data source"
  sync_interval = 1440
  ignore_rules = ".git\n.gitignore"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `source_url` (String)
- `type` (String) Valid values are `local`, `git`, and `amazon-s3`

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.
- `ignore_rules` (String)
- `parameters` (String)
- `sync_interval` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `file_count` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_synced` (String)
- `status` (String)
